)

  "actorType" text NOT NULL,
  "actorUserId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "id" text NOT NULL,

  "callerName" text,
  "collectedVariables" json,
  "consentToRecord" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "costCents" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "direction" text NOT NULL,
  "disconnectReason" text,
  "durationMs" int4,
  "dynamicVariables" json,

CREATE TABLE "public"."callTranscriptLine" (

  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "offsetMs" int4 NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "callTranscriptLine_role_check_c8727a17" CHECK ("role" IN ('AGENT', 'USER', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contact" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "notes" text,

  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceCallId" text,

)

  "image" text,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,

  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
